expectations.text: Data fetching is separated from rendering — either via a custom hook or a separate function, not inline in the component body
expectations.evidence: useUsers() custom hook fully isolates fetch logic; UserTable only calls the hook and renders

expectations.text: A loading state is explicitly handled and rendered (not just undefined/null)
An error state is explicitly handled and rendered
expectations.evidence:
error state renders

with the error message

expectations.text: Variables and functions have descriptive names that make their purpose clear without comments
expectations.evidence: useUsers, fetchUsers, isLoading, UserTableRow, UserTableBody — all self-describing
